Name: IS' Purple Hens
Author: Irkensnacks
Description:
I originally made this quick recolor for personal use, but I decided to upload it here just in case anyone else likes it. ^.^/

To use, simply replace the Blue Chicken.xnb and the BabyBlue Chicken.xnb with the provided files in your Stardew Valley>Content>Animals folder.

If there are any issues, please let me know. Enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Includes the .xnb files for the purple chicken and the baby purple chicken. Also includes two preview images and a back-up folder containing the original xnb files in case you want to convert back to the original colors.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
